title: Chat Suffix
description: Adds a suffix after your message
body:
The Chat Suffix mod allows you to automatically add a custom suffix to all chat messages. This solution is designed for players who want to differentiate their messages in a multiplayer environment or simply add a unique touch to their communications.
**functionality**
The mod integrates into the Minecraft client and modifies messages sent before transmitting them to the server. The system correctly processes all message types, excluding commands (lines beginning with the / symbol), ensuring full functionality of game commands.
**configuration**
The mod's main settings are stored in the configuration file:

```
minecraft/config/chatsuffix.toml
```
An alternative configuration method is available through the graphical interface, which is accessed by pressing the ** K** key (can be changed in the control settings).

_Settings changed through the game interface may not be saved when the client is restarted or the game world is exited. For permanent configuration, we recommend using a file-based configuration.
_
